frr_reconcile_interval.description: Time (seconds) between re-sync actions to ensure frr configuration is correct.

expose_tenant_networks.description: Expose VM IPs on tenant networks.

advertisement_method_tenant_networks.description: Advertise tenant networks per host or per subnet.

require_snat_disabled_for_tenant_network.description: Require SNAT on the router port to be disabled before exposing tenant networks.

expose_ipv6_gua_tenant_networks.description: Expose only VM IPv6 IPs on tenant networks if they are GUA.

ovsdb_connection.description: The connection string for the native OVSDB backend.

ovsdb_connection_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for the OVSDB connection transaction.

bgp_AS.description: AS number to be used by the Agent when running in BGP mode.

bgp_router_id.description: Router ID to be used by the Agent.

evpn_local_ip.description: IP address of local EVPN VXLAN (tunnel) endpoint.

evpn_nic.description: NIC with the IP address to use for the local EVPN VXLAN endpoint.

evpn_udp_dstport.description: The UDP port used for EVPN VXLAN communication.

clear_vrf_routes_on_startup.description: If enabled, all routes are removed from the VRF table at startup.

delete_vrf_on_disconnect.description: If enabled agent will take care of completely deleting VRF.

bgp_nic.description: The name of the interface used within the VRF.

bgp_vrf.description: The name of the VRF to be used.

bgp_vrf_table_id.description: The Routing Table ID that the VRF should use.

address_scopes.description: Allows to filter on the address scope.

exposing_method.description: The exposing mechanism to be used.

use_helper_for_ns_read.description: Use the root helper when listing the namespaces on a system.

root_helper_daemon.description: Root helper daemon application to use when possible.

ovn_nb_connection.description: The connection string for the OVN_Northbound OVSDB (local_ovn_cluster section).

external_nics.description: List of NICS that the local OVN cluster needs to be connected to.

peer_ips.description: List of peer IPs used for redirecting the outgoing traffic.

provider_networks_pool_prefixes.description: List of prefixes for provider networks.

bgp_chassis_id.description: The chassis_id used for the ovn-controller instance.

ovn_sb_private_key.description: The PEM file with private key for SSL connection to OVN-SB-DB.

ovn_sb_certificate.description: The PEM file with certificate that certifies the private key for OVN-SB-DB.

ovn_sb_ca_cert.description: The PEM file with CA certificate for OVN-SB-DB.

ovn_sb_connection.description: The connection string for the OVN_Southbound OVSDB.

ovn_nb_private_key.description: The PEM file with private key for SSL connection to OVN-NB-DB.

ovn_nb_certificate.description: The PEM file with certificate that certifies the private key for OVN-NB-DB.

ovn_nb_ca_cert.description: The PEM file with CA certificate for OVN-NB-DB.

ovn_nb_connection_ovn.description: The connection string for the OVN_Northbound OVSDB (ovn section).
